Sam / Marissa — quick legal update. Per Marissa's note, Redwood legal completed the first pass and highlights below. I attached our redlines export (2026-03-08-Redlines-MSA-v3.pdf) with in-line comments.

Key points:
- Liability cap: proposed cap = 2x annual fees; if Acme insists on a higher cap, we need commercial approval (Ben).
- Data residency: clarified that customer data will be processed in US regions by default; add optional EU processing in the Private deployment addendum (if customer requires).
- Security audit clauses: we accepted a standard SOC 2 Type II evidence request but limited frequency to once per 12 months and require redaction of third-party secrets.
- Indemnity / IP: retained standard Redwood language; we can discuss narrow carve-outs if Acme has practice-specific concerns.

Next steps / owners:
- Marissa: confirm whether Acme's legal wants tracked redlines or a clean mark-up (DOCX).
- Ben: if Acme pushes on liability cap, start escalation to pricing.
- Dev: provide SOC2 supporting docs to procurement portal link.

If we receive Acme's counter by Thu 03/05, Redwood can produce a negotiated MSA within 48 hours, assuming no material new terms.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
